summary: Verified source-aligned Calc ODS page master retention, native print option serialization and scale state.
findings: The pinned unused page style survives Worker and ODS round trips. Independent XML verifies all option groups, token order, direct/default behavior, signed first page numbers and scale precedence. All 53 scoped scenarios passed across the initial run and isolated retry.
residual_risks: This change covers represented print and master state. Broader page-style properties and native print rendering were outside the executed task.
